Matched ratio segments for m91, m94, m117, m118, m208, m98 and m75 teach local response shape and distinguish onset from finish. Matched loading or loading-solvent experiments for m120, m82 and m92 test dependencies that a molecule-only correction cannot learn. The remaining choices repair high-impact late failures in azaaromatic, phosphorus, aldehyde, alcohol, conjugated-carbonyl and related environments while adding compact halogenated and hydrophobic controls. This should improve generalization across the Row-distribution by learning both where corrections transfer and where they must stop, with labels covering V1 and V2 separately rather than treating interval width as uncertainty."}
